name: Planning Data development plan document dataset
fact: Planning Data lists 2,686 development-plan documents; collector last ran 23 July 2026 and the dataset is currently MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement.
gate: Document discovery is not proof a plan document is adopted, current or determinative for a parcel.

name: Planning Data development plan document type dataset
fact: The current catalogue exposes 16 development-plan document types including policies maps, site allocations, inspectors reports, viability studies and strategic flood-risk assessments.
gate: A document type is classification metadata, not evidence that a specific document or policy applies to a parcel.

name: Planning Data plan timetable dataset
fact: Planning Data reports 8,927 plan-timetable records from 73 providers; collector and newest data both reach 22 July 2026.
gate: Timetable milestones are process evidence only and must not be treated as adoption or site allocation.

name: Planning Data infrastructure project dataset
fact: The dataset contains 233 infrastructure-project records; boundaries are used for EIA consultation-body identification and the service warns they may change.
gate: An EIA consultation boundary is not a final DCO boundary, land-title boundary or delivery commitment.

name: Planning Data infrastructure project type dataset
fact: Ten infrastructure project types are listed, including electricity-line, energy, transport, water, wastewater, pipeline and generating-station.
gate: Project-type classification does not establish consent, construction, capacity or parcel uplift.

name: Planning Data infrastructure project document dataset
fact: The infrastructure-project-document dataset currently has zero records, zero providers and no collection attempt.
gate: Zero platform records must not be interpreted as absence of project documents; authoritative PINS/project sources remain required.

name: Planning Data infrastructure project document type dataset
fact: Five document types are defined: project acceptance letter, section 56 notice, site-visit report, decision notice and development consent order.
gate: The taxonomy is not evidence that any document exists for a particular project.

name: Planning Data infrastructure project log dataset
fact: The infrastructure-project-log dataset currently reports zero records and no collection attempt.
gate: Do not infer that an infrastructure project has no procedural history from an empty platform dataset.

name: Planning Data infrastructure project decision dataset
fact: Four decision categories are exposed: consent-granted, consent-rejected, withdrawn and appealed.
gate: Decision taxonomy alone does not identify the current decision state of an individual project.

name: Planning Data infrastructure project event dataset
fact: Nine procedural event categories are exposed, covering acceptance through examination, recommendation/decision, post-decision and withdrawal.
gate: A process-stage code is not consent or delivery evidence unless tied to a current authoritative project record.

name: Planning Data infrastructure funding statement dataset
fact: Planning Data reports 231 infrastructure funding statements from 46 providers; collector last ran 18 July 2026 and new data was found 2 July 2026.
gate: An infrastructure funding statement is authority-level funding evidence and does not prove a particular site's infrastructure is funded.

name: Planning Data site allocations document type
fact: MHCLG's controlled document type identifies site-allocation documents as a distinct plan-document category.
gate: A site-allocation document type is not a site allocation; the exact current document and policy must be verified.

name: Planning Data supplementary planning documents type
fact: MHCLG defines supplementary planning documents as a controlled development-plan document type.
gate: SPD classification does not make its contents adopted policy for a parcel without the current document and authority context.

name: Planning Data policies map document type
fact: MHCLG defines policies-map as a controlled development-plan document type.
gate: A policies-map category is not the current authoritative map geometry for any parcel.

name: Planning Data local authority district dataset
fact: Planning Data reports 344 English local-authority districts using ONS/OS boundary sources; newest data reaches 6 June 2026.
gate: Administrative geography is a routing/context layer, not planning permission or site readiness.

name: Central Bedfordshire local authority district entity
fact: The Central Bedfordshire entity has ONS reference E06000056, entry date 6 June 2026 and downloadable full geometry; quality is recorded as 'some'.
gate: Use for authority routing only; do not derive planning status from statistical-boundary membership.

name: Buckinghamshire local authority district entity
fact: The Buckinghamshire entity has ONS reference E06000060, entry date 6 June 2026 and downloadable full geometry; quality is recorded as 'some'.
gate: Administrative-boundary membership does not establish policy, allocation or capacity.

name: Preston emerging local plan timetable placeholder
fact: The Preston timetable entity is labelled 'Emerging new local plan', has entry date 30 March 2026, quality 'some' and notes that it is a placeholder to help the authority provide data.
gate: Placeholder timetable records must not be treated as authoritative evidence that the recorded milestone has occurred.

name: Planning Data document-type code finder
fact: The official dataset editor lists valid development-plan document-type codes used by the data model.
gate: Schema validation is not substantive planning evidence.

name: Planning Data document-type history
fact: The dataset editor exposes current development-plan document-type records and their entry dates/history.
gate: Schema history does not establish that an authority's document is current or adopted.

name: Planning Data document-type change log
fact: The change log records when controlled development-plan document types were added to the model.
gate: Metadata changes must not be converted into plan-status changes for a parcel.

name: Planning Data developer agreement dataset
fact: Planning Data reports 12,775 developer agreements from 78 providers; collector last ran 21 July 2026 and newest data reaches 6 June 2026.
gate: Agreement presence requires exact planning-application/site linkage and current legal status before use.

name: Planning Data developer agreement type dataset
fact: Three authoritative agreement types are defined: section-106, community-infrastructure-levy and section-278.
gate: Agreement type does not prove a signed, enforceable or outstanding obligation for a target site.

name: Planning Data developer agreement contribution dataset
fact: Planning Data reports 39,325 developer-agreement contributions from 77 providers; newest data reaches 6 June 2026.
gate: Contribution records require exact agreement/application linkage and must not be treated as project funding without status/transaction evidence.

name: Planning Data developer agreement transaction dataset
fact: Planning Data reports 49,891 developer-agreement transactions from 73 providers; collector last ran 21 July 2026.
gate: Transactions require exact agreement/contribution linkage and timing; they are not automatic evidence of remaining infrastructure funding.

name: Planning Data contribution funding status dataset
fact: Six authoritative funding statuses are defined: secured, received, allocated, transferred, spent and returned.
gate: Funding status must be tied to the exact contribution and project; category existence alone proves nothing about a site.

name: Planning Data planning application condition dataset
fact: Planning Data reports 5,305 planning-application conditions; collector last ran 22 July 2026 and the dataset is MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement.
gate: A condition record must be tied to the exact live permission and discharge status before affecting deliverability.

name: Planning Data local area requirements dataset
fact: Planning Data reports 335 local-area requirement records; collector last ran 18 July 2026 and origin is MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement.
gate: Local validation requirements are application-process evidence, not consent or parcel readiness.
